title: Store settings
summary: Your store's name, address, phone and logo, as POs, emails and the app show them.

blocks.text: Setup › **Store settings** holds the details printed on purchase orders and emails and shown in the app. Change a field and choose **Save**.

items: Your store's **time zone** is set when the store is created and isn't changed here. It decides "today" everywhere. Need it changed? Email {support_email}.
Your **Store ID** never changes. KloudC support can help if it must.
When KloudC offers it, you can ask for your store to move to its own server here.

blocks.text: Only owners and admins see this page.
